p: he immerses and … he may partake of his teruma, … he vomited … impure, … and

he immerses and then he may partake of his teruma, despite the fact that the impure ring is still inside him. The reason this is permitted is that since the ring in encapsulated inside the person’s body it cannot impart impurity. If he vomited out this ring it remains impure, as it was not purified by his immersion, and

w.9: vomited … impure … and … it renders him

one impure and one pure, … impure … does not render the pure … impure.
one impure and one pure, and they came in direct contact with one another. Rabba taught that even in this case the impure ring does not render the pure ring impure.
